# opnsense_monit_settings (Resource)

Monit general settings (Services > Monit > Settings): polling, the alert mail server, the local web interface and M/Monit. This is a singleton that always exists, so it must be imported before Terraform manages it (`id = "monit_settings"`); destroying it only removes it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_monit_settings.this
  id = "monit_settings"
}

# Turn Monit on and send alerts through the office relay.
resource "opnsense_monit_settings" "this" {
  enabled       = true
  interval      = 60
  mail_servers  = ["smtp.example.com"]
  mail_port     = 587
  mail_ssl      = true
  mail_username = "alerts@example.com"
  mail_password = var.smtp_password
}

variable "smtp_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Run Monit. Unset keeps the current value.
- `event_queue_path` (String) Directory that queues alerts while the mail server is unreachable; empty disables the queue. Unset keeps the current value.
- `event_queue_slots` (Number) Maximum queued alerts. Unset keeps the current value.
- `httpd_allow` (Set of String) Hosts or networks allowed to reach the web interface. Unset keeps the current value.
- `httpd_enabled` (Boolean) Run Monit's local web interface (needed for the status page and M/Monit). Unset keeps the current value.
- `httpd_password` (String, Sensitive) Web interface password. Unset keeps the current value.
- `httpd_port` (Number) Web interface port. Unset keeps the current value.
- `httpd_username` (String) Web interface user. Unset keeps the current value.
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks. Unset keeps the current value.
- `log_file` (String) Log file; empty logs to syslog. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mail_password` (String, Sensitive) Mail server password. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mail_port` (Number) Mail server port. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mail_servers` (Set of String) Mail servers for alerts, tried in order of preference. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mail_ssl` (Boolean) Use TLS to the mail server. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mail_ssl_verify` (Boolean) Verify the mail server's certificate. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mail_ssl_version` (String) TLS version: `auto`, `tlsv1`, `tlsv11`, `tlsv12` or `tlsv13`. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mail_username` (String) Mail server user. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mmonit_register_credentials` (Boolean) Register the web interface credentials with M/Monit. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mmonit_timeout` (Number) M/Monit timeout in seconds. Unset keeps the current value.
- `mmonit_url` (String) M/Monit server URL; empty disables reporting. Unset keeps the current value.
- `start_delay` (Number) Seconds to wait after boot before the first check. Unset keeps the current value.
- `state_file` (String) State file; empty uses the default. Unset keeps the current value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `monit_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The singleton always has this ID
terraform import opnsense_monit_settings.this monit_settings
```
